title: Design a Multi-Versioned Billing & Payment API
subtitle: Zero-downtime rolling microservices, Protobuf/Avro schema evolution, Idempotency & Contract DLQs
functionalReqs: Serve external merchant REST APIs across pinned date versions (`2024-05-01` .. `2026-01-15`) seamlessly alongside canonical internal gRPC services.
Guarantee forward and backward wire compatibility across 200+ weekly independent microservice deployments.
Quarantine malformed payloads cleanly into Dead-Letter Queues (`DLQ`) while enforcing idempotent billing invariants (`Idempotency-Key` + SHA-256 fingerprint).

nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: CI enforces `FULL_TRANSITIVE` compatibility across Protobuf/Avro schema updates.

nonFunctionalReqs.target: Zero double billing across network retries
nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: Unique `(merchant_id, key)` reservation checks request payload SHA-256 match.

nonFunctionalReqs.target: Core engine reads only canonical schema
nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: TPP Design by Contract isolates legacy JSON quirks strictly inside edge transformers.

explorerTopology.title: Contract-First Multi-Version Billing Pipeline
explorerTopology.subtitle: Date-Pinned Edge Adapter -> Canonical Protobuf gRPC -> Schema Registry -> DLQ
explorerTopology.overview: How Stripe-scale billing platforms decouple external legacy API versions from rapidly evolving internal Protobuf/Avro services.
keyTakeaways: Edge version translators keep core billing code clean (`vCurrent`) regardless of legacy external merchant API pins.
Every Kafka event embeds a 5-byte Schema ID and routes malformed payloads to DLQ without stalling partitions.

deepDives.title: Expand-and-Contract Zero-Downtime Rollouts
deepDives.bottleneck: Renaming or tightening schema constraints mid-deploy crashes pods on older/newer builds simultaneously.
deepDives.solution: Add optional new tag `#14`, dual-write/dual-read across mixed rollout, backfill, then deprecate legacy field cleanly later.
deepDives.tradeoff: Temporary schema verbosity replaces risky lockstep multi-service deployments.

deepDives.title: Fallacies of Distributed RPCs (Jitter, Deadlines, Digest Idempotency)
deepDives.bottleneck: Blind synchronous retries turn transient 50ms pauses into double-charged invoices or retry storms.
deepDives.solution: Pair caller-propagated gRPC deadlines, full-jitter exponential backoff, and `(key + payload_sha256)` ledger checks.
deepDives.tradeoff: Requires storing 24h key fingerprints in Postgres/Redis (~600 GB) cleanly.

criteria: Contrasts JSON vs Protobuf/Avro and explains tag rules for forward/backward compatibility
Isolates external version adapters cleanly so core billing runs one canonical schema
Enforces `(key + SHA-256 payload check)`, `409/422` status codes, deadlines & full jitter
Automates CI `FULL_TRANSITIVE` registry checks and isolates malformed records to a DLQ
